# Data

The simple DataTable and the editable DataGrid for finance tables.

[DataTable](#datatable) · [DataGrid](#datagrid) · [GridColumn and friends](#gridcolumn-and-friends) · [TryList](#trylist) · [Signed](#signed)

### DataTable

A simple sortable, clickable read-only table. For editing, grouping and totals use DataGrid.

```ts
import { DataTable } from '@/kit/components/data/DataTable'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `columns` *(required)* | `Column<T>[]` |  | `{ key, header, render(row), align?, sortValue?(row), width? }`. A column with `sortValue` is sortable. |
| `rows` *(required)* | `T[]` |  | The data. |
| `rowKey` *(required)* | `(row: T) => string` |  | Stable unique key per row. |
| `caption` *(required)* | `string` |  | Accessible table name (visually hidden). |
| `onRowClick` | `(row: T) => void` |  | Makes rows clickable and focusable (Enter and Space activate). |
| `selectedKey` | `string` |  | Key of the highlighted row. |
| `dense` | `boolean` |  | Tighter row padding. |
| `initialSort` | `{ key: string; dir: 'asc' \| 'desc' }` |  | Sort applied at first. |
| `empty` | `ReactNode` |  | Shown under the header when there are no rows. |

```tsx
<DataTable caption="Holdings" rows={rows} rowKey={(r) => r.symbol} initialSort={{ key: 'value', dir: 'desc' }}
  columns={[{ key: 'symbol', header: 'Symbol', render: (r) => r.symbol, sortValue: (r) => r.symbol }, { key: 'value', header: 'Value', render: (r) => money(r.value), sortValue: (r) => r.value }]} />
```

- Header buttons cycle ascending, descending, off and set `aria-sort`.

### DataGrid

A spreadsheet-style table for finance data: search, filters, sort, collapsible groups with subtotals, column visibility, editable cells, undo, autosave, totals, CSV export and pagination.

```ts
import { DataGrid } from '@/kit/components/grid/DataGrid'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` *(required)* | `string` |  | Header title and the table’s accessible name. |
| `unit` | `string` |  | Small label next to the title, e.g. the currency. |
| `columns` *(required)* | `GridColumn<R>[]` |  | The first column is the pinned row label; the rest are value columns. See GridColumn. |
| `rows` *(required)* | `R[]` |  | The data. |
| `rowId` *(required)* | `(row: R) => string` |  | Stable unique id per row. |
| `storageKey` *(required)* | `string` |  | Remembers column visibility, density and page size under this key, and names the CSV file. |
| `searchText` | `(row: R) => string` |  | What the search box matches. Defaults to the row label. |
| `onEdit` | `(changes: CellChange[]) => void` |  | Receives every edit, paste and clear as one batch (one undo step). Omit for a read-only table. |
| `groups` | `GroupOption<R>[]` |  | Ways to group rows. See GroupOption. |
| `defaultGroup` | `string` |  | Id of the group option applied at first. |
| `filters` | `FilterDef<R>[]` |  | Filters shown in the Filter menu and as chips. See FilterDef. |
| `detail` | `(row: R) => ReactNode` |  | Panel shown under a row when its chevron is opened. |
| `totalLabel` | `string` |  | Label of the totals row. Columns with `summary` are summed. |
| `history` | `GridHistory` |  | Undo and redo (see `useEditStore`). Enables the buttons, ⌘Z and the Undo message. |
| `save` | `GridSave` |  | Autosave status, switch and manual save (see `useEditStore().saveProps()`). |
| `apiRef` | `MutableRefObject<DataGridHandle \| null>` |  | Gives the page `exportCsv()` and `edit(changes)`. |
| `onInteraction` | `(event: GridEvent) => void` |  | Reports edits, sorting, filtering … for a “Try it” checklist. |

```tsx
const { edits, history, apply, saveProps } = useEditStore('budget')
<DataGrid title="Budget" unit="USD" storageKey="budget" columns={columns} rows={rows} rowId={(r) => r.id}
  onEdit={apply} history={history} save={saveProps()} totalLabel="Total" />
```

- Click selects a cell; Shift+click or Shift+arrows select a range and the footer shows its address (E4) and sum. Arrow keys, Tab, Home, End and PageUp/PageDown move.
- Enter, F2, double-click or just typing edits a number or text cell; Esc cancels; Delete clears the selection; paste from a spreadsheet fills cells.
- The row and column under the pointer (or the keyboard cursor) are highlighted; cells whose value changed flash briefly.
- Every change shows a message with an Undo button. Numbers are read with the site locale (`1.050.000` in Turkish, `1,050,000` in English).
- All text comes from `kit/components/grid/text.ts` (English and Turkish). Add a language there to translate the grid.

### GridColumn and friends

The types you pass to DataGrid: GridColumn, GroupOption, FilterDef, CellChange, GridHistory, GridSave, GridEvent and DataGridHandle.

```ts
import type { GridColumn, GroupOption, FilterDef, CellChange, GridHistory, GridSave, GridEvent, DataGridHandle } from '@/kit/components/grid/types'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` *(required)* | `string` |  | GridColumn: unique column id (also the key part of an edit). |
| `header` *(required)* | `string` |  | GridColumn: column title. |
| `value` *(required)* | `(row: R) => number \| string \| null` |  | GridColumn: raw value used for sorting, editing, sums, copy and export. |
| `format` | `(n: number) => ReactNode` |  | GridColumn: how a number is displayed, in totals and subtotals too. |
| `render` | `(row: R, value) => ReactNode` |  | GridColumn: custom cell content. |
| `editable` | `boolean` |  | GridColumn: the cell can be edited. |
| `hidden` | `boolean` |  | GridColumn: hidden until switched on in the Columns menu. |
| `focus` | `boolean` |  | GridColumn: highlight the column (e.g. the month under review). |
| `summary` | `'sum' \| ((rows: R[]) => ReactNode)` |  | GridColumn: totals row and group subtotals. |
| `minWidth` | `number` |  | GridColumn: minimum width in px. |
| `key` | `(row: R) => string` |  | GroupOption: the group a row belongs to. |
| `order` | `string[]` |  | GroupOption: group order. |
| `test` | `(row: R, value: string) => boolean` |  | FilterDef: whether a row matches an option; a row passes if it matches any selected option. |
| `rowId` | `string` |  | CellChange: the row that changed. |
| `colId` | `string` |  | CellChange: the column that changed. |

```tsx
const columns: GridColumn<Row>[] = [
  { id: 'name', header: 'Category', value: (r) => r.name, locked: true },
  { id: 'jan', header: 'January', value: (r) => r.jan, format: money, editable: true, summary: 'sum' },
]
```

### TryList

A “Try the features” checklist whose steps tick themselves off as the visitor does them. Optional “Do it for me” buttons run a step for them.

```ts
import { TryList } from '@/kit/components/grid/TryList'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `heading` *(required)* | `string` |  | Card title. |
| `tasks` *(required)* | `{ id: string; title: string; hint: string; action?: { label: string; run: () => void } }[]` |  | The steps. |
| `done` *(required)* | `ReadonlySet<string>` |  | Ids of finished steps (from `useTryList`). |
| `allDoneText` *(required)* | `string` |  | Message shown when every step is done. |
| `closeLabel` *(required)* | `string` |  | Accessible label of the hide button. |
| `onClose` *(required)* | `() => void` |  | Called when the card is hidden. |

```tsx
const tryout = useTryList('my-try', { edit: 'edit', undo: 'undo' })
<TryList heading="Try it" tasks={tasks} done={tryout.done} allDoneText="All done." closeLabel="Hide" onClose={() => tryout.setOpen(false)} />
<DataGrid onInteraction={tryout.onInteraction} … />
```

### Signed

Colors its content green for positive numbers and red for negative ones.

```ts
import { Signed } from '@/kit/components/grid/Signed'
```

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` *(required)* | `number` |  | The number whose sign decides the color. |
| `children` *(required)* | `ReactNode` |  | What to show. |

```tsx
<Signed value={change}>{fmt.moneySigned(change, 0)}</Signed>
```
